parsed.post: Discarding ASPECT_RATIO=64 experiment (val_bpb 1.0554 vs 1.0088). It seems the structural change negatively impacted convergence within the 5-minute window for my specific LR/warmup setup. Reverting to DEPTH=6, LR=0.05, WARMUP=0.1, AR=32. Next: testing a slightly higher MATRIX_LR with WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 to find a better stability/speed peak.
parsed.description: Reverting to previous best configuration and testing a slightly higher learning rate (0.07) with existing WARMUP_RATIO=0.1 to see if we can accelerate convergence without losing stability.
